notes_page.title: Notes
notes_page.empty_create_hint: No notes yet. Create the first page.
notes_page.empty_description: Pages can nest forever. They are private by default; the owner can share them with workspace members.
notes_page.share_no_agents: There are no agents in this workspace.
notes_page.share_no_channels: There are no group channels to share with.
notes_page.format_defaults_description: Applies to unstyled text in Notes. Selected text can still override color and size.
notes_page.export_description: Choose how to export the current note.
notes_page.export_pdf_description: Open the print dialog so you can save this note as a PDF.
notes_page.export_popup_blocked: Could not open the print window. Please allow pop-ups and try again.
notes_page.assistant_bubble_default: Chat about “{{title}}” with the Notes Assistant
notes_page.assistant_satellite_highlights_hint: Summarize this note and its child notes
notes_page.assistant_highlights_prompt: Summarize this note and its child notes. Use the notes tools to read the current page and its subtree, then outline each page's key takeaways, action items, and open questions. Do not restate the full text; keep it a readable outline.
notes_page.assistant_highlights_compose_hint: Edit the scope or focus, then send.
notes_page.assistant_setup_body_needed: Nothing is created until you click below. One-click use Wendy’s Computer and runtime, or open Create Agent to pick Computer and runtime yourself (other fields are prefilled). Opening the bubble again after deleting also returns here.
notes_page.assistant_setup_body_ready: To change Computer or runtime, open Members — or match Wendy’s Computer and runtime in one click.
notes_page.assistant_setup_wendy_missing: This workspace has no Wendy (onboarding agent) yet. Set up Wendy first, or choose a Computer and runtime yourself.
notes_page.assistant_setup_ensure_failed: Could not create the Notes Assistant. You may need admin permission, or it already exists.
notes_page.assistant_setup_ready_toast: Notes Assistant is ready — you can start chatting
notes_page.notes_assistant_required: Create the Notes Assistant first, then use note AI.
notes_page.retrospective_description: Aggregate issue activity and notes you touched in a time window into a private note under 回顾/. Week/month windows roll up day (or week) summaries instead of dumping raw events.
notes_page.retrospective_source_touched_notes_hint: Private notes you updated in the window
notes_page.retrospective_source_agent_runs_hint: Runs you initiated or on agents you own (short summary only — no thinking)
notes_page.retrospective_local_work_uncollected: Local machine work is not being collected
notes_page.period_brief_custom_range_invalid: Choose a valid start/end date (end cannot be before start)
notes_page.period_brief_agent_required: Create the Notes Assistant before writing a report.
notes_page.period_brief_collectors_empty: No collectors on your Computers yet. You can configure one below, or connect a Computer first.
notes_page.period_brief_collector_setup_body: This Computer is already chosen. Pick a runtime on it to create or repair the collector.
notes_page.period_brief_collector_missing_hint: No collector yet. Ignore to keep going with the other computers.
notes_page.period_brief_focus_placeholder: Paths, topics, a time range, or computers — typed text wins if it conflicts with the chips
notes_page.period_brief_compose_hint: Pick a time range and computers, then type a request below. Leave blank for a full-scope collect. Typed text wins if it conflicts with the chips.
notes_page.period_brief_started_hint: Collection and synthesis stay in this bubble — they will not jump to Messages.
notes_page.period_brief_created: Dispatched collectors for «{{title}}» ({{count}} facts); synthesizer wakes when packs settle
notes_page.period_brief_created_focused: Notes Assistant is directing collectors for «{{title}}» from your request
notes_page.ai_optimize_failed: The agent could not optimize the text.
notes_page.ai_optimize_timeout: Timed out waiting for the agent to optimize the text.
notes_page.share_description: Private by default. Members can see this page and its children. Agents can read this page only. Sharing with a channel lets its human members read this page and its children, and posts a note card in that conversation.
notes_page.no_other_members: There are no other members in this workspace.
notes_page.issue_refs_sync_failed: Note saved, but linking issues failed
notes_page.writeback_pending_hint: Review the proposal before it changes this note.
notes_page.writeback_accept_blocked: This proposal needs openable issue or run evidence before it can be accepted.
notes_page.writeback_preview_failed: Could not preview this writeback against the current note.
notes_page.delete_confirm: Delete "{{title}}" and the child pages you created? Notes created by others stay in their notebooks.
notes_page.remove_share_confirm: Remove "{{title}}" from your notes? Other people will not be affected.
notes_page.trash_description: Deleted pages stay here until you restore them.
notes_page.empty_trash_confirm: Permanently delete every page in trash? This cannot be undone.
notes_page.permanent_delete_confirm: Permanently delete "{{title}}" and its child pages? This cannot be undone.
notes_page.content_placeholder: Press Space to ask AI or '/' for commands

sandboxes_page.title: Sandboxes
sandboxes_page.description: Create internal sandboxes through the shared sandbox node connector.
sandboxes_page.create_dialog_description: Provide a sandbox name and node to create. Runtime model settings can be added later.
sandboxes_page.create_from_snapshot_dialog_description: Create a sandbox using this snapshot template. The node and template are fixed; you can set the name and runtime model.
sandboxes_page.create_from_snapshot_template_hint: Template is locked to this snapshot and cannot be changed.
sandboxes_page.select_node_hint: Select a node to view its sandbox instances
sandboxes_page.empty_node_description: No sandboxes on this node yet. Create one to get started.
sandboxes_page.endpoint_links_hint: Service URLs for this sandbox. Newly created Docker containers include Terminal, Pi Web, and noVNC links.
sandboxes_page.template_readonly_hint: The template cannot be changed after the sandbox is created.
sandboxes_page.node_readonly_hint: The node cannot be changed after the sandbox is created.
sandboxes_page.save_reconfiguring: Sandbox settings saved; applying runtime model configuration…
sandboxes_page.reconfiguring_hint: Restarting the Multica runtime inside the sandbox to apply the new model configuration.
sandboxes_page.runtime_model_hint: Model settings are sent to the sandbox runtime.
sandboxes_page.runtime_model_multi_hint: Add one or more providers. The selected default is what Pi uses unless an agent overrides the model.
sandboxes_page.no_bound_node: No sandbox node is bound to this workspace yet.
sandboxes_page.empty_description: Click Create sandbox to provision an isolated local environment.
sandboxes_page.snapshot_dialog_description: Name the snapshot and add an optional description. The name is sent to Cube; the description is stored in Multica only.
sandboxes_page.snapshot_description_placeholder: Optional: what this snapshot is for
sandboxes_page.snapshots_description: Cube snapshot templates created in this workspace, with name and description.
sandboxes_page.snapshots_empty_description: Use Snapshot template on a running sandbox to create one.

snapshot_delete_dialog.title: Delete snapshot?
snapshot_delete_dialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This also removes it from Cube and cannot be undone.

delete_dialog.title: Delete sandbox?
delete_dialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

sandboxes_page.add_node_permission_denied: Could not bind this sandbox node to the workspace. Confirm you are a workspace member and that you own the node.
sandboxes_page.setup_page_description: Run this command on the sandbox server. It writes {{file}} and starts sandboxd with the node key.
sandboxes_page.docker_empty_description: Create a Docker container from an image on this node. It will register a Multica runtime after boot.
sandboxes_page.docker_create_dialog_description: Choose a container name and Docker image. The runtime bootstrap matches Cube sandbox creation.
sandboxes_page.docker_description: Select a Docker image reported by this node. Multica starts a Docker container with the same runtime bootstrap used by Cube sandboxes.
sandboxes_page.docker_image_hint: Images come from Docker on the sandbox node.
sandboxes_page.docker_node_offline_hint: Bring this node online before creating a Docker container.
sandboxes_page.docker_images_empty_description: Make sure sandboxd is online and can run `docker image ls` on the node.
sandboxes_page.default_template_tab_description: Choose the Cube template used when creating sandboxes with template "default" on this node.
sandboxes_page.default_template_empty_options: No templates available yet. Wait for sandboxd to sync the Cube catalog, then try again.
sandboxes_page.default_template_sync_hint: Saved to Multica. A running sandboxd writes this into its local config file on the next heartbeat.
sandboxes_page.templates_description: Cube templates available on this sandbox node. The list is reported by sandboxd from the local Cube API.
sandboxes_page.templates_empty_description: Make sure sandboxd is online and can reach the Cube API. Templates appear after the next heartbeat.
sandboxes_page.templates_node_offline: Node is offline — showing last synced templates.
sandboxes_page.add_node_dialog_title: Run this command on the sandbox server
sandboxes_page.add_node_dialog_description: The command writes {{file}} and starts sandboxd with the new node key.

computer_update.progress_restarting: Restarting Computer on the new version…
computer_update.failed_generic: Something went wrong. Try again or open Computers for details.
computer_update.pinned: This computer is pinned to a fixed version and cannot self-update.
